title: Automata
body:
[[Finite Automata]]
[[Cellular Automata]]

Plural of *automaton*: an abstract machine defined by states and transition rules, with no
implementation implied. The index note for the machine ladder in
[[INTRODUCTION TO COMPUTABILITY]].

| Machine | Memory | Recognises |
|---|---|---|
| [[Finite Automata]] ([[DFA]] / [[NFA]]) | the current state, nothing more | [[Regular Languages]] |
| [[Pushdown Automata]] | a [[Stack]] | context-free |
| linear bounded automaton | tape limited to the input length | context-sensitive |
| [[Turing Machine]] | unbounded read/write tape | recursively enumerable |

Each rung adds memory and recognises strictly more, which is the [[Chomsky Hierarchy]].
[[Cellular Automata]] sit off the ladder entirely: same word, different idea.
